title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Outperform Even Take-Two's Expectations, GTA 5 Just Keeps on Selling
text: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Outperform Even Take-Two's Expectations, GTA 5 Just Keeps on Selling | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Take-Two Rockstar Games GTA Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 Pre-Orders Outperform Even Take-Two's Expectations, GTA 5 Just Keeps on Selling GTA 5 now at 235 million sales by Liam Croft 2 hours ago Share: We won't know how well GTA 6 is selling during its pre-order phase until after the game's launch next week, but with the biggest entertainment release of all time projected and now Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick talking up the numbers, we could be looking at some absurd sales stats. Speaking alongside the publication of financial reports, Zelnick said GTA 6 pre-orders are "running far in excess of our expectations". The game has been available to pre-order 25th June 2026, so they'll have been available for almost five months when GTA 6 finally comes out on 19th November. That's a long time to build up millions of pre-orders. "That’s a good thing. That said, we never claim success before it occurs,” Zelnick continued when talking to Variety . “So we’re just days away from beginning to see the fruits of our labour." Related Articles Guide GTA 6 Release Times and Preload: When Can You Start Playing? All the GTA 6 release info you need Rockstar will hope GTA 6 one day outsells GTA 5 , and here's its latest sales milestone: 235 million copies sold. Mental. That means it's sold another five million units in the last fiscal quarter, which last three months. For now, the option to preload GTA 6 is going live worldwide within the next 24 hours, with the full game launching for the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19th November 2026. Check our GTA 6 Release Times and Preload guide for more.
